gloss: lack of exercise; insufficient physical activity

definitions.gloss: lack of exercise; insufficient physical activity
definitions.explanation: the state of not getting enough physical exercise or activity

examples.japanese: {運動不足|うんどうぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{太|ふと}って→太る：01190_futoru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I gained weight due to lack of exercise.

examples.japanese: {運動不足|うんどうぶそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ジム→ジム：04735_jimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}い→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I started going to the gym to address my lack of exercise.

examples.japanese: ⟦デスク→デスク：23405_desuku⟧ワーク⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{運動不足|うんどうぶそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: If you do a lot of desk work, you tend to lack exercise.

notes:
USAGE:
Often said of oneself, as a mild worry or excuse: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{運動不足|うんどうぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧ (I've been getting no exercise lately and feel sluggish).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運動不足|うんどうぶそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧ - to deal with a lack of exercise
- {運動不足|うんどうぶそく}になる - to get too little exercise
- {運動不足気味|うんどうぶそくぎみ} - somewhat short of exercise
